## Follow-up Comments
Cover the truncation notice for length-stopped replies that include tool calls.
`237-249`: ** Trivial** · **Maintainability & Code Quality** · **Quick win** **Cover the truncation notice for length-stopped replies that include tool calls.** The length branch appends the notice after the content blocks and does not check for tool calls. The existing length tests use text-only replies, so a change that drops the notice for tool-call replies would not fail any test in this file. The `tool_use` stop reason in the suggested test follows from the existing stop-reason mapping.
Suggested test
```diff expect(message.content).toEqual([ { type: 'text', text: 'partial answer' }, { type: 'text', text: TRUNCATION_NOTICE }, ]) }) + +test('keeps the truncation notice when a length-stopped reply has tool calls', () => { + const message = convert({ + choices: [{ + message: { + content: 'partial answer', + tool_calls: [{ id: 'call-1', function: { name: 'Write', arguments: '{"path":"a.ts"}' } }], + }, + finish_reason: 'length', + }], + }) + + expect(message.stop_reason).toBe('tool_use') + expect(message.content.at(-1)).toEqual({ type: 'text', text: TRUNCATION_NOTICE }) +}) ```
